checks.describe: the compiled SchemaValidator on ServiceDefinition is the same object before and after a model_validate() call -- the schema is built once at class-definition time, not per call (section 2)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python3 -c "from platformops.servicedef import ServiceDefinition, GOOD_EXAMPLE; v1 = ServiceDefinition.__pydantic_validator__; ServiceDefinition.model_validate(GOOD_EXAMPLE); v2 = ServiceDefinition.__pydantic_validator__; print(v1 is v2); print(type(v1).__name__)"

checks.describe: a ValidationError.errors() entry carries the type/loc/msg/input keys as structured data, not a formatted string (section 3)
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python3 -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; bad = {**GOOD_EXAMPLE, 'environment': 'production'}; e = validate_service(bad)[0]; print(set(['type','loc','msg','input']) <= set(e.keys()))"

checks.describe: model_dump() followed by model_validate() reproduces an equal model -- the round trip covered in section 5
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python3 -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, ServiceDefinition, GOOD_EXAMPLE; svc = validate_service(GOOD_EXAMPLE); rt = ServiceDefinition.model_validate(svc.model_dump()); print(rt == svc)"
